QUOTE: it is enforced by how the primitives are written, plus a Valgrind test subset. The index only shows that test's name and brief, not its method.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer mentions a Valgrind test subset but frames the property as a coding discipline. It never says verification is a separate, off-by-default facility built on MSan/valgrind, nor that it is explicitly not part of the library API.
